architecture.mechanism: improvement in energy and power density
architecture.intervention: Replace or upgrade the transmission control unit's backup power source with a high-power-density lithium-ion battery module to maintain hydraulic pressure and electronic control during transient voltage drops, preventing sudden power loss.
architecture.expected_effect: The transmission system will maintain consistent power delivery and avoid sudden deceleration events caused by electrical supply instability.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the vehicle transmission control unit to simulated voltage sag conditions while monitoring output shaft torque; failure is confirmed if torque drops coincide with the voltage sag despite the new battery installation.
